title: Combat Enhanced: Relics & Abilities
description: Ever wanted a mod that enhaces Minecraft combat with unique weapons, summons, and clutch abilities? Then this mod is for you
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/671f159e526423d3880b60176159403b8403a352.png)

  Combat Enhanced expands combat in a meaningful way by adding a variety of new weapons (backsatabber, glass tools), armors (shulker armor, crown of the Nether) and few unique enchantments (one of them inspired from Minecraft Dungeons: Cowardice) that make every fight feel more dynamic.
![Zombie horse Rework](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3111499c69769391f7706a31cbe826648547af5.png)

With a special charm, you can summon a rideable zombie horse — the only one you’ll be able to mount. Any others spawned via spawn eggs (without the charm) won’t be rideable. Mounting a Zombie horse will give you a special effect called "Fearsome". All nearby entities will be affected with "Fear" increasing their movement speed but decreasing their attack damage and armor. All undead mobs are immune to "Fear"
![New Resource: Bogdium](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b363d14dcde31191c35f41503f9bbd47de5d4ba.png)

On top of that, the mod introduces a brand-new ore built around life absorption called Bogdium. An entity stepping on a Bogdium Ore will get weakened and loose health but a sword crafted by this matrerial will become unbreakable if you keep killing enemies or other entities. Whether you're looking for stronger gear, darker themes, or fresh combat mechanics, this mod adds depth without straying from the core experience.

### **New Revenge Effect**
From now on when a horse, cat or dog of yours dies, you will be affected with the "Revenge" effect that increases your movement speed and attack damage.

Please report any bugs you find. I recommend using JEI for the recipes.
![In the last update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/096913ed772afb8fbb031c39eed0f7427cbcc229.png)

Update name: Elemental:

In this update:

-Added new tool called "Abyssal Staff" (allows you to summon drowned that can't hurt you while you hold the staff in your main hand)

-Enchantments: 

1.Ambush (Abyssal Staff): Makes nearby drowned invisible while targeting someone they deal more damage while invisible
2.Royal Services (Abyssal Staff): Makes nearby drowned faster, stronger and more resistant
3.Emergency Getaway (Shulker Armor): When your health drops below 50% you get levitated upwards (fast) and you gain slow falling so that you land elsewhere safely
4.Gold Rush (Crown of the Nether): When your piglin guardian is killed, you gain increased speed.
5.Spectral Connection (Chestplates for now): Summons a spectral Avatar that assists you in combat, but be careful if he dies, you might too

-Fixed some bugs
*Note: The Spectral Avatar is experimental for now as I found some bugs. He will be fixed soon.
